scope: Application state, rendered controls, validation, draft/download contents and absence of unexpected network calls. Platform adapters do not test layout, native dialog focus trapping, real media playback or actual browser downloads.

checks.name: All displayed inline action functions exist
Four hero selectors update image and selected state
Category filters return 1 architecture, 2 interiors, 1 detail, 4 total
Combined filters have a useful empty state and reset
All four study dialogs open with matching content and close
Search filters and opens the matching study
Ground and first floor show their own hotspots
Mirror has reversible visual and pressed state
All four room controls update their own image, description and ideas
Three palettes update four finish records and selected state
All twelve journey cards select their matching banner
Scale planner converts 40 squares to 372 square metres and adds chosen mood
Blank form cannot open a brief
Valid form creates an editable brief including the chosen direction
Editing brief synchronizes the explicit email draft
Download contains the reviewed text and correct filename
Closing review preserves original form details
Study-to-enquiry action preserves its destination and text focus
Film loads on request and pauses on dialog close
Privacy and preview details open as real dialogs
Mobile menu state is reversible
Official icon subset resolves every displayed icon
